title: Feature brief
description: What shipped, in the words of the repository. Produced by discover.mjs from the GitHub repo; every claim carries a citation so the script can never assert something the code does not support.

summary.description: One sentence a customer would understand.

shippedAt.description: ISO date of the earliest evidence that this reached customers.

repo.description: GitHub owner/name. The primary source — a local checkout is optional.

localPath.description: Local clone used, if any. Absent means everything came from the GitHub API.

capabilities.description: The concrete things the feature lets someone do. Each becomes a candidate scene.

statement.description: Plain-language capability, e.g. 'orders paid in the app appear in the ledger automatically'.

evidenceRefs.description: Ids into the evidence array. A capability with no evidence is dropped, not softened.

surface.description: Where a user sees this: a route, screen or component name.

surfaces.description: UI surfaces found in the repo that the demo build can reconstruct.

storyId.description: Storybook story id, when one exists — prefer this over a reconstruction.

elements.description: Labels, fields, buttons and states read from source. The demo build uses these verbatim so the reconstruction matches the product.

evidence.description: Every citation backing this brief. The script writer may only make claims traceable to one of these.

ref.description: Commit SHA, PR number or tag.

excerpt.description: The actual text read. Not a paraphrase.

excluded.description: Candidate claims deliberately dropped, and why. Keeps the next run from re-proposing them.
